LeaseMode.description: Whether a Run survives its client's disconnection (RS-21).

oneOf.description: The Run ends when the client disconnects. The default (RS-21, RS-23).
The Run survives the disconnect until the TTL expires (RS-21, RS-23).

ttl_ms.description: How long, on the host monotonic clock (RS-22).

description:
What the Manifest records of a Lease: its mode and whether it was released. The
token and the expiry deadline are runtime state only: the token is the credential
adoption checks (R5), and the deadline is a host monotonic instant with no
meaning outside the process (RS-22).

Rule: RS-38.
